title: Aromatic Peruvian Chicken Aji De Gallina
description: This Peruvian dish features shredded chicken in a creamy aji amarillo pepper sauce, served with rice and boiled potatoes, and is made satvik-friendly by substituting traditional heavy cream with a cashew cream alternative.
instructions: Roast the aji amarillo peppers in a 400 degree oven for 30 minutes, then peel and chop them.
In a blender, combine the roasted peppers, yuzu kosho, garlic, and onion, and blend until smooth.
In a large saucepan, combine the blended pepper mixture and cashew cream, and stir over low heat until warm and creamy.
Add the cooked chicken to the saucepan and stir to coat with the pepper sauce.
Season the chicken and sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and sauce over boiled potatoes and steamed rice.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and a sprinkle of toasted peanuts.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
